brief:
The Prisoners' Media Office has warned of immediate threats to the lives of Palestinian women held in Damoum prison, citing assaults and medical negligence, Shehab Wire reported. The office disclosed that three female detainees face critical health conditions.

The warning highlights deteriorating conditions at the facility, with the media office pointing to systemic abuse and inadequate medical care as primary concerns for the detained women.

title: Prisoners' media warns of imminent danger to women detainees in Damoum prison
